item.title: Portland Man Receives Consecutive Life Sentences In Sumner County Child Abuse Case
item.description: A Portland man will spend the rest of his life in prison after receiving the longest child sexual abuse-related sentence in Sumner County history. On Thursday, Criminal Court Judge Dee David Gay sentenced Walter Lucian Lewis, 32, to three consecutive life sentences without the possibility of parole, plus an additional 60 years.
